notes.title: v1.2 - Progress Update
notes.notes:
Children of the Polaroid, rise...

It's been a while, hasn't it? Last time I said anything about Polaroid was around 3 months ago, hah. So, I'm sure some of you are wondering: What has happened with v1.2 since the last progress update?

Well... a lot has happened.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288183/bf70fb6740b53bba6bb63d43fa4f5ae3c762ee9f.jpg
So, to begin with, I've been working on many, MANY graphical adjustments, such as adding more details to areas, improving textures a little bit (while keeping the pixelated look) and improving the post processing effects. I've also been, as you can see above, implementing a cutscene system. This has certainly helped with the pacing of the game and everything, and it also looks pretty nice.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288183/794dd46a83295fc1a4155cde7cd6ba4913492d29.png
Now, another thing I've been working on is a whole lotta new areas! Like, a LOT of new areas.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288183/fe03730bada0b006b6d4c4bef656b145b9f73246.png
With these new areas come new enemy types, items, story tidbits, etc. and there's A LOT for you to explore! A lot of passion has been put into everything, and I really hope everyone enjoys it when it releases!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288183/cf7d975aa51827e50b329004fc5419f02d27fa1a.jpg
So, the big question is:
When is v1.2 going to release?
Late 2023.

That is all I'm going to say, I need to get back to working on Polaroid and all of my other dormant game projects (wishlist them all on Steam hehe)

See y'all later!
- Dante Garner

P.S. Console ports may/may not start development after v1.2 releases ;)

notes.title: Where is the v1.2 Update?
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

So I know I've been a bit silent when it comes to Polaroid's development, but I just want to say that everything has been going pretty well for dev-related stuff! I've been working on a lot of things for the game, and I just wanted to give a bit of an explanation on what is coming for the game!

So, to start off...
Polaroid will be split up into chapters!
That's right!
Now, what this means for the game is that it's going to be split up into 5 different sections, similar to games like Bendy and the Ink Machine & Poppy Playtime (probably the worst examples I could've used, but oh well.) The names for each of these chapters are:

 Chapter One - Enter the Polaroid
 Chapter Two - The Darkness Overtaken
 Chapter Three - Welcome to The Cabins
 Chapter Four - The Optical Arrives
 Chapter Five - The Last Picture

Gameplay Mechanics are being more refined!
Yep! Things like the camera, the axe and the overall gameplay loop are being changed quite a bit! An example of one of these changes are that you have to collect film to use the Polaroid camera, meaning, yes, you can run out of film. This means you have to be much more careful when it comes to using your camera!

Another gameplay mechanic being introduced is health!
You're going to have to be much more careful when it comes to avoiding the shadow people, because rather than outright killing you, they're going to try damage you (at least until you kill them with the camera...) and certain shadows do more damage (the brutes, the crawlers, the finders, etc.) so you'd going to have to make sure you get rid of them as quickly as possible!

The Story of Polaroid is going to make much more sense!
So, something I have to admit about the story in the current version of Polaroid.... I didn't really come up with one. I just kind of added random things here and there to make it seem like there was a story, but I just didn't really bother with one. BUT, in v1.2, there's going to be a LOT of story for you to find out about! Things like the VHS tapes and notes are going to be remade, there are going to be new cutscenes that give a little bit of context into what's going on in the game, and many other things.

Hard Mode will finally be implemented! (and with it, a new ending...)
Since launch, you haven't been able to play on hard mode. My reason for this is because there's a new ending for it that I've been working on, and I've also been trying my hardest to make sure it's still fair. But, alas, you will finally be able to play through it with this update! The new ending for this mode goes pretty damn hard not gonna lie, and I think people will enjoy it a lot!

And lastly, there will be many more secrets.....
There will be plenty.....

So yeah! That's a glimpse into what is in store for Polaroid's next update! I'm sorry that I don't have any screenshots or anything to show, but I intend on updating the steam page for the game soon, so I'll let y'all know when I do that!

Thank you for reading, and w̷̭̚ȅ̵̡͉̱̝̩̅̉͝'̴̡̨̝̌̏͊͜l̵̢̟̩̞͈̈́ĺ̴͇̱̣̬̲̃ ̵͙̿s̵̥̥͊̔ě̸̼e̷͉̺̺̭̘͆̏ ̷̘͐̍̆y̵̲̳̣̣͋͂́̔õ̴̩̤̰̑͆͝u̶̯͌ ̷̡̖͙̗̇̂̄͊͘s̵̲̠̹̒̑̓̍̆ͅo̵͉͊͒͜o̸̦̅̈̎̀ͅn̵̢͓̮̔̐͌̾͠ ̵̭̤͖̯̽͆͝;̴̜͗)̶̝̗͂

notes.title: POLAROID - POST-LAUNCH UPDATE PLAN
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Thank you for a relatively successful launch for Polaroid! I'm thankful for everyone who has bought the game, and I appreciate everyone who has put the game in their wishlists!

I'm hard at work on the next update for Polaroid, which I hope to release within the next week or so. Here is what you can expect from this update (or future updates):


 New settings (Invert mouse, and disable particle effects)
 Jim's arms will be fixed (yes, I know his arms are broken 😥)
 The cutscene where you get knocked out will be improved, and make more sense
 Shadow people in the Cabins won't be able to walk through walls anymore
 The finder's AI will be improved drastically
 Hider's introduction will last a bit longer, with more dialogue
 Hoping to add subtitles for people who cannot understand the dialogue
 Volume settings
 Camera icon won't display unless you're actually holding the camera
 Make the 7 in the Cabins puzzle more obvious that it's... well, a 7. (People thought it was a 1...)

And hopefully many more bug fixes n what not!

Unfortunately, hard mode won't be implemented in the next update, as I'm making sure it's balanced, and that the hard mode ending actually makes sense (the second ending requires you to beat hard mode, meaning it's currently unaccessible (sorry completionists! You're going to have to wait until the next update!))

I also want to make sure people understand that I (Dante Garner) am the only person working on Polaroid, so updates may take a while to release. I'm working on it as hard as I possibly can, and I hope to release these updates as soon as possible!

To help me out with bug fixes, please report any bugs you encounter throughout your playthrough here or through the official Polaroid discord server.

Thank you for reading, and I hope people continue to enjoy Polaroid!
- Dante Garner

P.S. If you've enjoyed the music in Polaroid, you'll be able to buy the soundtrack very soon!
